description: Transcribes speech from an audio file path (VARCHAR) or from audio bytes (BLOB) and returns the full text. The optional model overrides the whisper_model setting.
Translates speech in any supported language from an audio file path (VARCHAR) or from audio bytes (BLOB) into English text. Requires a multilingual (non-.en) model.

Transcribes an audio file path (VARCHAR) or audio bytes (BLOB) into timestamped segments: segment_id, start_time, end_time, text, confidence and language. Optional arguments override the model and language settings; translate = true translates the speech to English.
example: SELECT start_time, end_time, text FROM whisper_transcribe_segments('audio.wav', 'tiny.en');

description: Lists all supported Whisper models with their download status: name, is_downloaded, file_size, file_path and description.
Downloads a Whisper model into the whisper_model_path directory and returns a status message. Does nothing if the model is already downloaded.
Returns one row describing the currently configured model: current_model, model_path, is_downloaded, file_size, language and threads.
Lists the available audio input devices (device_id, device_name). Use a device_id with the recording functions or the whisper_device_id setting.
Records audio from the microphone for a fixed number of seconds and returns the transcribed text. Optional arguments override the model and input device.

Records audio from the microphone until silence_seconds of silence are detected or max_seconds is reached, then returns the transcribed text. Omitted arguments fall back to the whisper_silence_duration, whisper_model and whisper_silence_threshold settings.
Records audio from the microphone for a fixed number of seconds and returns the speech translated to English. Requires a multilingual (non-.en) model.
Samples the microphone for a few seconds and reports the peak and RMS amplitude with a suggested whisper_silence_threshold value.
Records a spoken question from the microphone and returns the SQL generated by the text-to-SQL proxy at whisper_text_to_sql_url, without executing it.
Records a spoken question from the microphone, converts it to SQL via the text-to-SQL proxy at whisper_text_to_sql_url, executes the query and returns its result.
Like whisper_voice_query, but prepends _generated_sql and _transcription columns to the query result.
Returns the whisper extension version and the bundled whisper.cpp version.
Checks whether an audio file can be opened and decoded by FFmpeg. Returns 'OK' on success, or 'Error: <reason>' otherwise.
Returns one row of audio file metadata: file_path, duration_seconds, sample_rate, channels, format and file_size.
Returns all effective whisper settings as a comma-separated key=value string.
Returns the current whisper_device_id setting (-1 means the default device).
Returns the current whisper_max_duration setting in seconds.
Returns the current whisper_silence_duration setting in seconds.
Returns the current whisper_silence_threshold setting (RMS amplitude).
Returns the current whisper_text_to_sql_url setting (the text-to-SQL proxy URL).
Returns the current whisper_text_to_sql_timeout setting in seconds.
Returns the current whisper_voice_query_show_sql setting.
